about: GTA VI fan theories shown at /theories/ and on the homepage. Updated nightly by the Claude research task (see docs/THEORIES.md), which opens a pull request. These are fan ideas, not facts: every item needs at least one source that shows fans discussing it. 'for' = what fans point to; 'against' = official Rockstar facts or strong counter-points. status: open | likely | long-shot | confirmed | debunked. trend: rising | steady | cooling. Items are shown in this order. image = an official image name from docs/THEORIES.md (credited Image: Rockstar Games); related = article slugs the theory is shown inside. Keep each id stable forever: votes are stored by id.

items.title: GTA IV's Tony Prince and Luis Lopez return
items.summary: Fans think a recent pre-load promo video sets up a reunion of Gay Tony and Luis Lopez from GTA IV: The Ballad of Gay Tony, 17 years later.
items.imageAlt: A couple dancing in a neon-lit Vice City nightclub
for: Players say they spotted telling clues to both characters in a pre-load promo video released last week.
Fans note Tony would be in his early 60s by 2026, which they say fits the older man they spotted.
A second wave of posts this week says a bearded man with glasses in a brief shot of a recent Rockstar clip has Tony's face and voice.
against: Neither character appears in Rockstar's official GTA VI character profiles.
Skeptics note Rockstar could simply have reused a voice actor for a new character.

sources.title: GTA 6 could reunite two beloved GTA 4 characters after 17 years as gamers spot telling clues

items.title: Liberty City is a secret second map
items.summary: A long-running theory got a boost from the latest trailer: fans think part of GTA VI, maybe Lucia's backstory or a later expansion, takes place in Liberty City.
items.imageAlt: A news helicopter flying over wooded hills in Leonida at sunset
for: Rockstar's own profile of Lucia says her family's history goes back to Liberty City.
Fans have spotted Liberty City references in the trailers, such as a license plate and bikers wearing Liberty City hats.
against: Every official Rockstar map and region description covers only the state of Leonida; Liberty City is mentioned only as part of Lucia's past.
Skeptics argue a reference is just a reference: GTA games often name-drop other cities without letting you visit them.

GTA 6 Keeps Pointing at Liberty City Whether It Means To or Not

items.title: Jason is descended from Red Dead 2's Arthur Morgan
items.summary: Fans keep saying Jason looks just like Arthur Morgan, and some go further: they think he is Arthur's descendant, tying GTA VI to Red Dead Redemption 2.
items.imageAlt: Jason Duval in a U.S. Army T-shirt holding a pistol, with Lucia Caminos holding a shotgun beside him, above Vice City at dusk
for: Fans compare Jason's face, expressions and overall look in the official screenshots to Arthur Morgan's.
Some point to Jason's pose in a promo for the Hawk & Little "Morgan" revolver, which they say echoes Red Dead Redemption 2's cover art.
against: Rockstar's official profile says Jason grew up around grifters and crooks and joined the Army, and mentions no family link to anyone.
In Red Dead Redemption 2, Arthur's only known son died before the game begins, so a direct line of descent would need an explanation Rockstar has never hinted at.

items.title: Lucia will betray Jason
items.summary: The most debated theory: at some point Lucia turns on Jason, perhaps by informing on him or handing him to the police.
items.imageAlt: Lucia Caminos braced for a fight
for: Fans point to a trailer moment where Lucia hugs Jason while holding a gun behind his back.
Rockstar's own profile says meeting Lucia "could be the best or worst thing" for Jason, which theorists read as foreshadowing.
against: Rockstar's official synopsis says the two are "forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive."

sources.title: GTA 6 Fans Spot a Worrying 'Foreshadowing' Detail
Lucia Can Betray Jason During the Story of GTA 6, New Theory Claims

items.title: The "three birds" hint at something big
items.summary: Redditors noticed that several pieces of official GTA VI artwork feature exactly three birds. Some think they stand for Michael, Franklin and Trevor; others think they hint at an unrevealed third playable character.
items.imageAlt: GTA VI key art: Jason and Lucia above Vice City with birds in the sky
for: The same three-bird detail shows up across multiple official artworks, which fans argue is deliberate.
against: Rockstar's official synopsis and website name only two leads: Jason and Lucia.

sources.title: GTA 6 Already Has a Mystery Players Are Trying to Solve

items.title: GTA VI turns into a dark psychological thriller
items.summary: A popular Reddit theory says the sunny crime-spree marketing hides a darker second half: a Red Dead 2-style conspiracy where Jason and Lucia are manipulated or betrayed by people far above them.
items.imageAlt: Lucia Caminos in handcuffs and an orange prison jumpsuit, led through a jail with other inmates
for: The theory's author reads Rockstar's official synopsis as hinting at forces bigger than Jason and Lucia closing in on them.
Fans note Rockstar's last story game, Red Dead Redemption 2, also turned darker in its second half.
against: Rockstar's official synopsis frames the story as a crime saga, with the pair "forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive", and says nothing about a conspiracy.
Rockstar hasn't commented on the theory.

sources.title: GTA 6 synopsis hides massive psychological thriller plot twist, Redditors claim

items.title: Jason is an undercover cop
items.summary: Some fans believe Jason started out working undercover and fell for Lucia along the way.
items.imageAlt: Vice City police officers at a nighttime traffic stop
for: Theorists point to trailer moments they read as Jason watching or reporting on the people around him.
against: Rockstar's official profile describes Jason as ex-Army and working for drug runners in the Keys, with no law-enforcement link.
Critics point out that Jason and Lucia take on police in the trailers, which is hard to square with an undercover role.

sources.title: GTA 6 fans believe Jason might be an undercover cop

items.title: Jason and Lucia get a Bonnie-and-Clyde ending
items.summary: Many fans are convinced the story ends tragically for at least one of the leads, and say the trailers have already given it away.
items.imageAlt: Jason and Lucia in bandanas, outlaw-style, at a Vice City gas station
for: Fans read the outlaw-couple imagery in the trailers as a nod to Bonnie and Clyde, whose story ends in death.
against: Rockstar hasn't said anything about the ending, and GTA endings have often depended on player choice.

sources.title: GTA 6's ending has already been spoiled, fans agree

items.title: Phil Cassidy (or his son) is back
items.summary: A mulleted man in an in-game Ammu-Nation ad has fans convinced the classic Vice City arms dealer, or a relative, is returning.
items.imageAlt: An armed robber in a bandana inside a Leonida store
for: The man in the Ammu-Nation ad shares Phil's trademark look, and Phil ran guns in Vice City.
against: Fans point out that Phil lost an arm in Vice City, so some think this is his son rather than Phil himself.
Rockstar hasn't confirmed any returning characters.

items.title: Michael De Santa is coming for his boat
items.summary: A boat near Jason's home looks a lot like Michael's yacht from GTA V, so some fans think GTA V's lead turns up in Leonida.
items.imageAlt: Boats and jet skis crowding the water off Leonida
for: Fans say the boat's design closely resembles the yacht from GTA V.
against: A similar-looking boat is more likely a reused vehicle model than a story clue, and Rockstar hasn't confirmed any GTA V characters.

sources.title: "He's coming, for his boat": GTA 6 fans speculate GTA 5's Michael to return in Vice City

items.title: GTA 6 will be delayed a third time
items.summary: A rumor that GTA VI would slip again spread fast online and even moved prediction-market bets.
items.imageAlt: GTA VI key art with the November 19, 2026 release date
for: The rumor grew from a reporter's comment about Red Dead Redemption 2's delay pattern, which was passed around as a prediction.
against: Rockstar's official site still says November 19, 2026, and pre-loading opened on November 10.

sources.title: GTA 6 speculation mutates into delay 'rumor,' leading to anxious fans and a prediction market betting frenzy for no good reason
